rationale: After the customer's open-circuit reading, the assistant correctly concluded the heater has failed and that the fix is a new pump/heater assembly. It gave safe isolation advice, a sanity check on the meter, and did not claim compatibility, telling the customer to verify the part by model/FD number. It gave no cost figure and weighed repair against replacement only loosely, though the customer said the machine is 9 years old, which the assistant never used. The earlier turns also hedged slightly oddly ('can't look up what E:09 means') and called it a 'budget-range machine' without evidence.
